cards.title: Bulleted lists
cards.body: `<ul>` makes a bulleted list. Each item goes in its own `<li>`.

cards.title: Numbered lists
cards.body: Swap `<ul>` for `<ol>` and the items get numbers instead of bullets.

check.question: Which tag holds one item of a list?
check.explanation: `<li>` is one list item. `<ul>` holds the whole list, and `<item>` is not an HTML tag.

exercise.prompt: Make a heading `Shopping list` and a bulleted list with at least three items.
exercise.starterCode: <!-- a heading, then a ul with three li items -->

checks.label: A `<ul>` holds at least three `<li>` items
